palette.instructions: First picture the single most iconic image of the theme in `state` as it shows up in Brazil — a product, a landscape, a dish, a costume, a festival, a flag, a machine; whichever a Brazilian pictures first. Then spread the probability across the colors that image actually is, strongest color first. Green is the easiest color to over-pick here: give it weight only when the image itself is clearly green — crops, forest, a green flag — never as a default for anything Brazilian.

criteria.rich_black: Near-absolute black, ink, void, matte darkness.
criteria.charcoal: Dark grey, smoke, stone, overcast gloom.
criteria.gray: Mid grey, concrete, rain, industrial tones.
criteria.silver: Light grey, steel, chrome, metallic sheen.
criteria.chestnut: Dark brown, bark, dried blood, old sepia.
criteria.lime_green: Electric yellow-green, toxic or neon green.
criteria.cyan: Bright cyan, neon, holograms, tech glow.
criteria.sky_blue: Pale blue, daytime sky, open air.
criteria.baby_blue: Very pale soft blue, pastel sky, hazy calm.
criteria.blue: Clear blue, uniforms, water, cool tones.
criteria.navy: Deep blue, night sea, dark uniforms.
criteria.purple: Rich purple, demonic or royal tones.
criteria.royal_purple: Deep regal purple, velvet, imperial robes.
criteria.magenta: Hot pink-purple, neon, idol stage lights.
criteria.baby_pink: Very pale pink, blush, pastel rose.
criteria.maroon: Dark red, dried blood, heavy drama.
criteria.crimson: Deep saturated red, arterial blood, banners.

destaque.instructions: Which single Brazilian state (or the Federal District) best embodies the theme in `state`?

regiao.instructions: Which region of Brazil is most strongly associated with the theme in `state`?

criteria.norte: North: AC, AP, AM, PA, RO, RR, TO. Amazon rainforest, rivers.
criteria.nordeste: Northeast: AL, BA, CE, MA, PB, PE, PI, RN, SE. Coast, sertão, semi-arid.
criteria.centro_oeste: Center-West: DF, GO, MT, MS. Cerrado, Pantanal, agribusiness, the capital.
criteria.sudeste: Southeast: ES, MG, RJ, SP. Largest cities, industry, finance.
criteria.sul: South: PR, RS, SC. Temperate, European immigration, gaúcho culture.
criteria.nenhuma: The theme has no regional association, or it is not a meaningful theme.
